svg.aria-label: Bathochromic, hypsochromic, hyperchromic and hypochromic shifts
svg.title: Bathochromic, hypsochromic, hyperchromic and hypochromic shifts
svg.desc: Four panels of absorption curves illustrating red shift, blue shift, intensity increase and decrease
svg.text: Spectral shifts: how structure changes λmax and intensity
Grey dashed = reference compound; coloured = after the structural change
Causes: extended conjugation, –NR₂ / –OH auxochrome, polar solvent
Causes: loss of conjugation, protonation of –NH₂ (→ –NH₃⁺), twisting
Causes: adding an auxochrome, greater planarity of the chromophore
Causes: twisting out of plane, steric hindrance, aggregation
